 Impregnable 'Peyz-Keria' Duo... T1 Beats KC 3-1 to Face BLG in Semifinals
 Yeonjae "Arra" Shin 
 arra@inven.co.kr 
 Nov 6, 2026 
 Korean (한국어) 
 KO 
 Add us on 
 ©Riot Games World-class bot duo 'Peyz' and 'Keria' erected a giant wall in front of Karmine Corp. T1 defeated Karmine Corp 3-1 to advance to the semifinals, where BLG awaits.
 First blood in Game 4 came in the top lane. 'Canna' Kim Chang-dong's Renekton heavily pressured 'Doran' Choi Hyeon-jun's Camille and called over 'Yike's Wukong to secure the kill. For T1, it was all the more unfortunate as 'Oner' Mun Hyeon-jun's Nocturne ultimate was spent in the process. Leveraging Renekton's influence, Karmine Corp also secured the dragon.
 T1 fought back through the power of their bot lane. 'Peyz' Kim Su-hwan's Miss Fortune and 'Keria' Ryu Min-seok's Neeko, who held firm control over the laning phase, moved up to top lane to eliminate Renekton alongside Camille and Nocturne. In exchange for giving up a second dragon to the opponent, T1 first picked off 'Busio's Rakan, who had engaged somewhat overzealously, and finished off Renekton as well to make up for the loss.
 Around the 21-minute mark, Karmine Corp's third dragon spawned. T1, having taken position first, safely finished off the dragon and traded junglers. From that situation, T1's main force, which had taken a step back, wiped out Karmine Corp's retreating champions through aggressive play from Miss Fortune. The decision to instantly close the distance using a Blast Cone and forward Flash to secure a double kill was exceptional.
 Karmine Corp took a major breather by chasing down T1 after they secured Baron to pick up kills. By picking off 'Faker' Lee Sang-hyeok's Annie in the mid lane, they even took the global gold lead during the opponent's Baron power play. However, the power of Miss Fortune—who was still deathless—remained immense, and that strength was clearly on display in full teamfights. With a triple kill from 'Peyz', T1 reclaimed the momentum.
 Around the 32-minute mark, T1 secured the Dragon Soul while the opponent's focus was drawn to Camille. Karmine Corp pursued relentlessly to gain a bigger payoff, but they collapsed completely against Neeko's surprise ultimate followed by Miss Fortune's explosive damage. It was the decisive moment. With Camille drawing attention once again, T1 eliminated Renekton, pressed their numerical advantage, and pushed in to end the game.
 Originally written in Korean, this article was translated with AI assistance and edited by a native English-speaking editor. Every translation is reviewed by our editorial team before publication.
